town_hall.name: Town Hall
town_hall.description: Primary base core building. Destruction grants 1 star and unlocks the full loot payout.
town_hall.notes: Core building near base center, critical tactical target.

clan_castle.name: Clan Castle
clan_castle.description: Holds defensive clan troops and treasury resources.
clan_castle.notes: Lure defensive troops or trigger early with high HP troops.

gold_storage.name: Gold Storage
gold_storage.description: Vats containing stored gold. Primary objective for gold farming.

elixir_storage.name: Elixir Storage
elixir_storage.description: Glass vats containing stored elixir. Essential for army training.

dark_elixir_storage.name: Dark Elixir Storage
dark_elixir_storage.description: Deep black rectangular storage holding Dark Elixir for heroes.
dark_elixir_storage.notes: Highest priority resource target for hero upgrades.

gold_mine.name: Gold Mine
gold_mine.description: Extracts gold from the ground on the base perimeter. Holds uncollected gold between hauls.
gold_mine.notes: Usually on outer ring, high loot reward when uncollected.

elixir_collector.name: Elixir Collector
elixir_collector.description: Pumps elixir from the ground on perimeter.
elixir_collector.notes: Usually on outer ring, high loot reward when uncollected.

dark_elixir_drill.name: Dark Elixir Drill
dark_elixir_drill.description: Extracts dark elixir on base edges.

eagle_artillery.name: Eagle Artillery
eagle_artillery.description: Long-range map-wide defense activated after 180-200 housing spaces deployed.
eagle_artillery.notes: Avoid triggering too early with mass deployment.

inferno_tower.name: Inferno Tower
inferno_tower.description: Melts tanks (single target) or fries swarms (multi-target).

x_bow.name: X-Bow
x_bow.description: Rapid-fire mechanical defense, ground or air-and-ground.

air_defense.name: Air Defense
air_defense.description: Hidden Tesla-style rocket launcher that fires long-range homing missiles at air units.
air_defense.notes: Primary threat to air armies - prioritize destroying for dragon attacks.

mortar.name: Mortar
mortar.description: Fires explosive shells killing barch/goblins in clusters.

wizard_tower.name: Wizard Tower
wizard_tower.description: Fires orbs of magic dealing area splash damage to swarms.
wizard_tower.notes: Dangerous for barch and goblin clusters.
